text:
anna: Quick sync — trying to rebalance Q2 roadmap. ACME just escalated a request for low-latency embeddings + SLA. We don't have capacity for everything. Thinking about reweighting RICE and sequencing. short takes?

mike: What's the current RICE for realtime embeddings? Last I saw Impact=8, Reach=0.2, Confidence=60%, Effort=6 -> score ~0.16.

jess: We had Reach low bc only one customer asked. ACME + another pilot ups reach to ~0.3. Confidence should be ~70% after the spike tests.

carlos: From sales: this is high priority — could unlock 2 contracts (~$1.2M ARR) and prevent churn at FortuneX. High downside if we miss.

priya: Telemetry note: streaming/real-time paths are 12% of requests but account for ~30% of token cost. If cost goes up per-token, net value might be lower than raw ARR suggests.

anna: Options on the table: A) Prioritize realtime embeddings (shift eng capacity, potential big customer win). B) Defer realtime, ship batching + prefix cache improvements that help more customers. Need a principled RICE call + launch criteria.

mike: Effort wise realtime requires infra changes + 2 weeks perf loop. Batching/cache is lower risk, ~1 week and broader impact.

jess: Rough RICE calc to compare: realtime -> Reach 0.3, Impact 8, Confidence 0.65, Effort 6 => (8*0.3*0.65)/6 = 0.26. Batching -> Reach 0.6, Impact 3, Confidence 0.8, Effort 3 => (3*0.6*0.8)/3 = 0.48. So batching wins by score.

carlos: :thinking_face: Sales argues realtime's strategic value > immediate score. It's stickiness and enterprise readiness.

anna: Proposed launch criteria (so we don't argue scope endlessly):
- Realtime embeddings: 95th p99 latency < 200ms, token cost delta <= +10%, integration guide, and 2 pilot customers live.
- Batching+cache: +20% throughput on common routes, prefix cache hit >= 30%, no regression on 95th latency.

mike: If we want both, my suggestion: do batching first (2 sprints), then allocate dedicated cycle for realtime. This reduces risk and buys telemetry for a better Impact estimate.

jess: :thumbsup: Agreed. Also propose adding a gating policy: realtime only moves up if sales secures at least one paid pilot and legal OK for second by EOD Friday.

carlos: I can get one paid pilot committed this week. Second is blocked on legal but I can escalate.

roadmap-bot: Plan change proposal posted: https://redwood/roadmap/q2-scope. Please vote with reactions.

priya: FYI I updated the impact model in the shared sheet with revised ARR and cost deltas so numbers above reflect that.

jess: Locking decision unless we get two paid pilots: batching-first, realtime as follow-up initiative. If sales confirms two paid pilots by Fri EOD we re-evaluate and can move realtime up.

anna: Sounds good. Thanks everyone — I'll update the roadmap doc and add the launch criteria + gating conditions.

mike: lgtm

carlos: will chase legal

anna: closing thread — please react or reply if you disagree within 24h.
